input: Review this proposal: a bearer-authenticated webhook may supply actorId in its JSON body, and the gateway will use that actor for the work item. Approve or reject it and state the required correction.

facts: ACS authorization is bound to a registered actor and exact requested actions.
Webhook payloads are untrusted input even after transport authentication.
Audit records must preserve redacted trigger provenance.
constraints: Do not weaken approval or policy checks.
Give a concise decision and correction.

rubric.description: Binds a verified principal to a registered actor server-side.
Preserves exact-action policy and approval checks.
Requires redacted trigger provenance in audit records.

reference.content: Reject. Derive the canonical actor from the authenticated principal, ignore or reject payload actorId, then create the normal policy-gated work item with redacted trigger provenance.
